items.source: The rollback rule for all Exceptions, including checked exceptions.
items.translation: 所有 `Exceptions`（包括受检异常）的 回滚规则。

items.source: The rollback rule for RuntimeExceptions.
items.translation: `回滚规则` 针对 `RuntimeExceptions`。

items.source: Each rule is based on an exception type or exception pattern, supplied via RollbackRuleAttribute(Class) or RollbackRuleAttribute(String), respectively.
items.translation: 每个规则都基于一个异常类型或异常模式，分别通过RollbackRuleAttribute(Class)或RollbackRuleAttribute(String)提供。

items.source: When a rollback rule is defined with an exception type, that type will be used to match against the type of a thrown exception and its super types, providing type safety and avoiding any unintentional matches that may occur when using a pattern. For example, a value of jakarta.servlet.ServletException.class will only match thrown exceptions of type jakarta.servlet.ServletException and its subclasses.
items.translation: 当定义带有异常类型的回滚规则时，该类型将用于与抛出的异常及其超类型进行匹配，从而提供类型安全性并避免使用模式匹配时可能出现的意外匹配。例如，值为 `jakarta.servlet.ServletException.class` 的规则仅会匹配类型为 `jakarta.servlet.ServletException` 及其子类的抛出异常。

items.source: See the javadocs for @Transactional for further details on rollback rule semantics, patterns, and warnings regarding possible unintentional matches with pattern-based rules.
items.translation: 有关回滚规则语义、模式以及关于可能与基于模式的规则发生非预期匹配的警告的更多详细信息，请参阅 @Transactional 的 javadocs。

items.source: See the javadocs for @Transactional for further details on rollback rule semantics.
items.translation: 有关回滚规则语义的更多详细信息，请参阅 @Transactional 的 javadocs。

items.source: See the javadocs for @Transactional for further details on rollback rule semantics, patterns, and warnings regarding possible unintentional matches.
items.translation: 有关回滚规则语义、模式以及可能意外匹配的警告的更多详细信息，请参阅 @Transactional 的 javadocs。

items.source: For improved type safety and to avoid unintentional matches, use RollbackRuleAttribute(Class) instead.
items.translation: 为了提高类型安全性并避免意外匹配，请使用 `RollbackRuleAttribute(Class)` 而不是。

items.source: When comparing roll back rules that match against a given exception, a rule with a lower matching depth wins. For example, a direct match (depth == 0) wins over a match in the superclass hierarchy (depth > 0).
items.translation: 在比较与给定异常匹配的回滚规则时，匹配深度较低的规则优先。例如，直接匹配（depth == 0）优于在父类层次结构中的匹配（depth > 0）。

items.source: When constructed with an exception pattern via RollbackRuleAttribute(String), a match against a nested exception type or similarly named exception type will return a depth signifying a match at the corresponding level in the class hierarchy as if there had been a direct match.
items.translation: 当通过 RollbackRuleAttribute(String) 构造函数使用异常模式构建时，对嵌套异常类型或名称相似的异常类型的匹配将返回一个深度值，表示在类层次结构中的相应层级处发生了匹配，就像直接匹配一样。

items.source:
Multiple such rules can be applied to determine whether a transaction
should commit or rollback after an exception has been thrown.
items.translation: 可以应用多条此类规则，以确定在抛出异常后事务是应该提交还是回滚。

items.source:
This is the preferred way to construct a rollback rule that matches
the supplied exception type and its subclasses with type safety.
items.translation: 这是构建回滚规则的首选方式，该规则能够以类型安全的方式匹配所提供的异常类型及其子类。

items.source: Get the configured exception name pattern that this rule uses for matching.
items.translation: 获取此规则用于匹配的已配置异常名称模式。

items.source: -1 means this rule does not match the supplied exception.
items.translation: -1 表示此规则不匹配提供的 exception。

items.source: 0 means this rule matches the supplied exception directly.
items.translation: 0 表示该规则直接匹配提供的 exception。

items.source: Any other positive value means this rule matches the supplied exception within the superclass hierarchy, where the value is the number of levels in the class hierarchy between the supplied exception and the exception against which this rule matches directly.
items.translation: 任何其他正值表示此规则在超类层次结构中匹配提供的 `<code>exception`》，其中该值是在提供的 `<code>exception` 与该规则直接匹配的异常之间的类层次结构中的层级数。

items.source: When a rollback rule is defined with an exception pattern, the pattern can be a fully qualified class name or a substring of a fully qualified class name for an exception type (which must be a subclass of Throwable), with no wildcard support at present. For example, a value of "jakarta.servlet.ServletException" or "ServletException" will match jakarta.servlet.ServletException and its subclasses.
items.translation: 当定义回滚规则并指定异常模式时，该模式可以是完全限定类名，也可以是用于匹配异常类型（必须是 Throwable 的子类）的完全限定类名的子字符串。目前不支持通配符。例如，值为 "jakarta.servlet.ServletException" 或 "ServletException" 将匹配 jakarta.servlet.ServletException 及其子类。

items.source: Create a new instance of the RollbackRuleAttribute class for the given exceptionType.
items.translation: 为给定的 `exceptionType` 创建一个新的 `RollbackRuleAttribute` 类实例。

items.source: Create a new instance of the RollbackRuleAttribute class for the given exceptionPattern.
items.translation: 为给定的 `exceptionPattern` 创建一个新的 `RollbackRuleAttribute` 类实例。

items.source: Return the depth of the superclass matching, with the following semantics.
items.translation: 返回匹配父类的深度，其语义如下。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied exceptionType is not a Throwable type or is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的 exceptionType 不是 Throwable 类型或为 null

items.source: exceptionType - exception type; must be Throwable or a subclass of Throwable
items.translation: exceptionType - 异常类型；必须是Throwable或Throwable的子类

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied exceptionPattern is null or empty
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的 exceptionPattern 为 null 或为空
